fields.description: 4to. ff. [3], pp. xxix, 525, [1]. Original Roxburghe boards. John Payne Collier’s own copy, inscribed to him by Earl Powis ‘with the best compliments & thanks of the Roxburghe Club.’ The ‘Howard Household Books,’ are two manuscript books detailing the household expenses of Sir John Howard and his son Thomas. Regular accounts for the period 23 February 1481-20 October 1483 are followed by miscellaneous entries made between 1484 and 1491. Collier had called attention to theatrical entries in them in his ‘History of English Dramatic Poetry’ (see Bib# 584555/Fr# 922 in this collection). Collier’s personal part in the present edition is, aside from transcription, relatively minor: 29 pages of largely summary ‘Introduction’ and a sprinkling of illustrative footnotes and glosses.
